text: That sounds like classic angina. Have you ever been diagnosed with high blood pressure, high cholesterol, or diabetes? Also, do you smoke or have a family history of heart disease? REQUEST TEST: ECG

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the ischemic ECG and normal BNP, we need to rule out coronary artery disease definitively. Have you noticed any changes in your cholesterol levels or blood pressure in the past? REQUEST TEST: Lipid_Panel and CBC.

speaker: Doctor
